Headquarters: New York, NY (Remote)

At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for a Buisness Development Representative, Consultant & Broker Channels (BDR, Consultant & Broker) to join our sales team. The Business Development Representative, Consultant & Broker Channels is responsible for expanding and strengthening the organization's presence within the healthcare consultant and broker ecosystem. This role will focus on developing relationships with national and regional consulting and brokerage firms, identifying key stakeholders and influencers, generating awareness of the organization's solutions, and nurturing prospective opportunities that can lead to new business and channel partnerships. The BDR will execute strategic, multi-channel outreach to consultant and broker organizations across the country through personalized email, phone, social selling, industry networking, and other targeted engagement strategies. The individual will conduct research to understand each firm's areas of influence, client base, priorities, and market position, using these insights to develop relevant and compelling engagement strategies. Working directly with the SVP, Channel Partnerships, this role will serve as a critical engine for expanding the consultant and broker channel pipeline. The BDR will maintain consistent engagement with prospective partners, coordinate meetings and introductions, track relationship progression, and ensure promising opportunities are appropriately qualified and advanced within the channel partnership process.  To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

• Consultant and Broker Relationship Development

• Build and maintain a strong network of relationships with healthcare consultants, brokers, advisors, and other influential industry stakeholders.

• Identify and engage key decision-makers, influencers, and relationship owners within national and regional consulting and brokerage firms.

• Establish the organization as a trusted and knowledgeable resource within the consultant and broker community.

• Develop relationships over time through consistent, thoughtful, and value-added engagement.

• Strategic Outreach and Business Development

• Develop and execute targeted outbound campaigns to consultant and broker organizations through email, phone, LinkedIn/social selling, events, networking, and other channels. 

• Research target firms, their areas of specialization, client portfolios, market priorities, and key stakeholders to create highly personalized outreach strategies.  

• Generate new conversations and qualified opportunities that align with the organization's growth and channel partnership objectives.  

• Leverage industry events, conferences, webinars, and other networking opportunities to expand the organization's consultant and broker relationships.  

• Opportunity Identification and Nurturing

• Identify emerging opportunities within consultant and broker organizations and proactively nurture relationships through the sales cycle.  

• Maintain consistent follow-up with prospects that are not yet sales-ready, keeping the organization top-of-mind for future client opportunities.  

• Understand consultant and broker influence within prospective accounts and identify opportunities where channel relationships can accelerate growth.  

• Coordinate introductions and discovery meetings between consultants/brokers and the appropriate internal sales or channel partnership leaders.  

• Maintain accurate and timely documentation of relationship activity, opportunities, next steps, and pipeline progression within CRM systems.  

• Channel Pipeline Development  

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective consultant and broker relationships and opportunities.  

• Partner closely with the SVP, Channel Partnerships to prioritize target firms, develop account strategies, and determine appropriate engagement approaches.  

• Provide regular reporting on outreach activity, relationship development, pipeline progression, and emerging market opportunities.  

• Identify trends, competitive dynamics, and market intelligence gathered through consultant and broker interactions and communicate relevant insights to leadership.  

• Internal Collaboration  

• Collaborate with Channel Partnerships, Sales, Marketing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure coordinated engagement with consultant and broker partners.  

• Support preparation for consultant/broker meetings, presentations, industry events, and partnership discussions.  

• Help develop and refine messaging, materials, and engagement strategies designed specifically for the consultant and broker audience.  

• Support broader channel partnership initiatives and strategic growth priorities as directed by the SVP, Channel Partnerships.

• Performance & Results  

• Consistently achieve activity, relationship-development, qualified-opportunity, and pipeline-generation objectives.  

• Demonstrate disciplined follow-through and accountability in managing a large portfolio of prospective relationships.  

• Continuously test and refine outreach strategies to improve engagement, conversion, and channel pipeline performance.  

• Perform other related duties as assigned.  

About You 

• 2 - 5+ years of experience in healthcare, behavioral health, benefits, consulting, brokerage, business development, sales, or partnerships.  

• Experience working with or selling through healthcare consultants, benefits consultants, brokers, or other channel partners strongly preferred.  

• Demonstrated ability to develop relationships with senior stakeholders and build credibility within complex organizations.  

• Strong prospecting and business development skills, including experience with email, phone, LinkedIn/social selling, networking, and other outbound strategies.  

• Highly proactive, self-motivated, and comfortable independently managing a large portfolio of relationships and prospects.  

• Strong research and business acumen with the ability to understand an organization's business model, priorities, and key stakeholders.  

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to different audiences.  

• Strong organizational and follow-up skills with the ability to manage multiple relationships and opportunities simultaneously.  

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where opportunities may develop over an extended period.  

• Goal-oriented and results-driven, with a strong commitment to building sustainable relationships rather than simply generating transactional leads.  

• Collaborative team player who thrives in a mission-driven environment.  

• Experience with Salesforce or other CRM platforms preferred.

Benefits 

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA

• 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%

• Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.

• Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care

• Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment

• Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events

• Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount! 

Compensation

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grows dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs for external users and internal Stripe teams. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible.

What you’ll do

You will manage a team of Associates. You will act in a player-coach capacity and are accountable for supporting associates in delivering against target set goals and mentoring in subject matter expertise.

Responsibilities

  • Ongoing management of the operational performance of your team to deliver KPIs
  • Manage capacity and scheduling, dividing and assigning work between team members
  • Ensuring your team has all the skills and resources needed to be successful in their role
  • Setting clear goals and expectations for individual and team performance
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement to refine team processes and procedures
  • Support recruitment and hiring initiatives
  • Coach and mentor individuals for career progression via structured career development conversations
  • Provide continuous performance feedback and facilitate periodic formal performance reviews
  • Drive and own initiatives that make the team a warm and welcoming place to work
  • Implement process improvements that enhance team productivity, reduce manual effort, and improve user experience

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years experience leading operations teams
  • Excellent interpersonal and communications skills
  • Exemplary planning and time management skills
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with multiple, cross-functional stakeholders to achieve results
  • Previous experience mentoring others and are able to constructively provide feedback to others
  • Ability to motivate the team and keep them engaged in an otherwise structured process
  • Proven ability to be subject matter experts in the relevant line of business
  • Previous experience in a team lead or people management role
  • Prior experience in customer service or internal/external user-facing operations

Preferred qualifications

  • Uses data to set priorities, track progress, and spot trends before they become problems. Comfortable building or maintaining dashboards and interpreting operational metrics
  • Brings numbers into conversations naturally and grounding decisions in evidence and making tradeoffs visible, not just reporting what the data says

6d8d62464d5b9f44.description: Job Purpose : We are seeking a highly skilled ETL Data Engineer to re-engineer our existing data pipelines to extract data from a new data source (PostgreSQL / CURA system) instead of the current Microsoft SQL Server (CRM persistence store), while preserving the existing load patterns to Elasticsearch and MongoDB. The engineer will ensure this migration has zero impact on data quality, system performance, or end-user experience. Key Responsibilities : - Analyze existing ETL pipelines and their dependencies on Microsoft SQL Server as source systems. - Design and implement modifications to repoint ETL extractions from PostgreSQL (CURA) while preserving the current transformations and load logic into Elasticsearch and MongoDB. - Ensure end-to-end data integrity, quality, and freshness remain unaffected after the source switch. - Write efficient and optimized SQL queries to extract data from the current source. - Conduct performance testing to confirm no degradation of pipeline throughput or latency in production. - Work closely with DevOps and platform teams to containerize, orchestrate, and deploy the updated ETLs using Docker and Kubernetes. - Monitor post-deployment performance and handle any production issues proactively. - Document design, code, data mappings, and operational runbooks. Required Skills and Qualifications : - Strong experience building and maintaining large-scale distributed data systems. - Expert-level proficiency in Python, especially data analysis/manipulation libraries like pandas, NumPy, and Polars. - Advanced SQL development skills with proven experience in performance optimization. - Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes. - Familiarity with Elasticsearch and MongoDB as data stores. - Experience working in production environments with mission-critical systems. .
